The Nubisco icon family: one design language, one card per product. The living visual reference (rendered at 512, 48 and 28 px) is the [icon system artifact](https://claude.ai/artifact/D2T9CazKYEtsCgzDJ1jSof); this page is its permanent record in the manual. Master SVGs are attached to this document as they are finalized.

> [!NOTE]
> Fourteen of the sixteen masters are embedded below. Tally and DoodLoop are still text-only: their masters are large enough that they need the binary upload path rather than inline attachment, so they will be added directly from the source files.

## Design language

- **Ribbon letterforms**: the initial, sculpted as a tapering calligraphic band
- **Gradient along the stroke**: color travels the ribbon, as on the N itself
- **Glass and shadow**: white light on the top edge, occlusion where ribbons cross
- **Product colorway**: each app recolors the ribbon with its own palette

Most products carry a concept glyph nicknamed in lowercase; the N mark itself is reserved for infrastructure (Platform) and for Nubisco UI, because the library is Nubisco itself.
